Podcast Hosts Lounge

This lounge is for people who make podcasts. We talk about microphones, editing, hosting platforms and guests. Many members ask about USB versus XLR microphones; see the gear wiki before asking. Our weekly thread on interview technique is pinned.

  1. You may promote your own podcast once a month in the Promo Monday thread; promotional posts anywhere else will be removed.
  2. Bots, auto-posters and RSS feeds that post automatically are not permitted.
  3. Keep audio clips under two minutes.

Editing questions are welcome at any level.
